# Oakland Schools Online Studies (Moodle)

> A Moodle-based online learning platform serving K-12 districts across Oakland County, Michigan with virtual courses, professional development, and multilingual curriculum.

Oakland Schools Online Studies provides a centralized learning management system for Oakland County school districts. The platform leverages Moodle to deliver online courses, including world languages (Spanish, French, German, Japanese), STEM courses, and professional development opportunities through partnerships with DSS K12 and MLO Virtual Courses.

## Platform Access & Navigation

- [Oakland Schools Online Studies](https://moodle.oakland.k12.mi.us/os): Main portal for Oakland Schools online learning platform serving K12 districts in Oakland County
- [Login to Oakland Schools Online Studies](https://moodle.oakland.k12.mi.us/os/my/courses.php): User authentication and dashboard for accessing enrolled courses

## Course Directory & Categories

- [OSOnlineStudies: Course Categories](https://moodle.oakland.k12.mi.us/os/course/index.php): Complete course directory and category listing for all available online learning offerings
